verdict.rationale: Vast.ai publishes its own REST API reference section and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, which together form the base of an API reference. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive (a try-it console or playground) or embeds runnable examples; the example commands shown are for the CLI and SDK, not the reference itself. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable per-endpoint examples, hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Vast.ai REST API gives you programmatic control over the entire platform. It's the foundation that the CLI and SDK are built on.
